records.title: Published microbial and molecular assays of Yungay subsurface clay samples
records.coordinate_scope: Sampled subsurface clay material, including40cm horizon. Laboratory assay results are not current in-situ whole-cell biomass.
records.period: Soil samples collected2017–2018; publication2020; individual assay dates unavailable.
records.summary: Respiring microbial colonies: Laboratory CTC staining and fluorescence microscopy reported metabolic activity in sampled clay aggregates. Lipid biosignatures: GC–MS reported heptadecane, phytol derivatives, squalene, crocetane and iso/anteiso carboxylic acids. These are molecular observations and context-dependent taxonomic interpretations, not a direct count of all corresponding organisms.

observations.label: Reported SYBR-stained cell count
observations.method: Direct microscopy after SYBR Green I staining; Methods describe2weeks incubation at37°C before enumeration
observations.qualifier: at least; lower bound; laboratory processed samples
observations.scope: Clay-bearing samples; not unincubated in-situ abundance

references.title: Inhabited subsurface wet smectites in the hyperarid core of the Atacama Desert as an analog for the search for life on Mars
references.locator: Results/Figures4–6; Methods Bacterial counts, Microscopy, Lipid extraction/analysis.

limitations: The cell count followed sample incubation/processing; do not label it fresh in-situ biomass or compare directly with CFU/g.
A molecule alone is not definitive proof of a particular taxon or of Martian life.
Some material may reflect downward transport from surface organisms.
This is an already documented Earth benchmark, not a new TerrainX biological discovery.
records.next_measurement: Collect permitted sterile co-located samples with field/extraction blanks and unincubated counts; compare microscopy, culture-independent assays and lipid recovery.

limitations: Independent reference measurements are not new discoveries or cell-wide observations; candidate F/U/C are unchanged.
Named cave existence may be documented while exact entrance coordinates/survey epoch remain unknown. Recreation-site points are not surveyed entrances.
Historical permafrost temperature is not ice mass fraction. LCROSS abundance is local ejecta retrieval, not a lunar reserve or a measurement at another feature.
Microscopy/staining, incubation-derived counts, mineral phases and particle-size fractions are different observables. Read each method and spatial scope.
